idea-plugin.name: Copilot Effort Guard
idea-plugin.description:
Shows how hard the GitHub Copilot model is struggling, as a colour bar in the status bar and in a tool window.
  • Status bar: 🟢 ▰▱▱ 1/3, a segmented bar of struggling turns in a row, with a colour per state.
  • Tool window Effort Guard: big bar, progress towards a clean run, coloured history of the last turns, advice, Chat and CLI side by side (each with its own streak) and sessions.
  • Advice in two steps: raise the thinking effort, then switch to a more powerful model; downgrade when the task looks easy.
  • Reset button (and Tools | Effort Guard: Reset) after changing model or thinking effort.
It reads the state written by the hooks of copilot-effort-guard (node scripts/install.mjs --user), so the hooks must be installed first. Works with the Copilot CLI run from the IDE terminal, and with any Copilot agent that runs the hooks.

action.text: Effort Guard: Reset After Changing Model or Thinking
action.description: Starts the Effort Guard evaluation again (streaks back to zero)
